title: Wasm public arithmetic hotspots
objective: Accelerate the public moebius.range normal heavy case with one bounded source-transparent packed sieve call, exact fallback, Node-Wasm/direct-Wasm/disabled-native differentials, fixed route evidence, and a representative benchmark

handoff.summary: The public moebius.range(0, stop) normal heavy case now uses one bounded source-transparent linear-sieve call for 1024 <= stop <= 2097152. CPython/scalar, JavaScript disabled-native, inspected-core, direct Wasm, public Node-Wasm, authenticated fixed-route, malformed-storage, exceptional-bound, and representative benchmark evidence is checked in. At stop=10000 the measured public Node-Wasm median was 51.3 ms versus 601.5 ms for the scalar portable loop, with one crossing and exact digest [10000,-23,6083,[0,1,0,1,-1,1,0,1,1,0]].
risks: The maximum packed case owns 48 MiB across output and workspace; larger and shifted intervals deliberately retain the scalar fallback until a segmented ABI is justified.
The lane cannot pass architecture:packages until integration assigns the new arithmetic package in the shared package graph.
next_steps: Integration must add the arithmetic package to pyrightconfig.json and architecture/package-graph.json, register packed-moebius-range-production, add the focused test and benchmark scripts, and add the public moebius-range-batch corpus workflow requiring kernel:packed-moebius-range-production.
After shared-manifest integration, rerun architecture:check and the aggregate Node-Wasm corpus.
